case_name: Nadirsha Shapurji Patel (D) By Lrs. & Ors. v Deputy Collector & La & Anr
petitioner: Nadirsha Shapurji Patel (D) By Lrs. & Ors
facts: By this common judgment and order we propose to dispose of all the aforesaid appeals which are connected and interrelated, as would be indicated from the facts delineated hereinafter.

Possession of the said land was also taken over on 18.06.1986 and an award was passed by the Land Acquisition Officer, determining market value of the land and awarding compensation at ' 3.50 per square meter for the acquired land.

The Chief Project Manager [GTPP], Delhi, made a proposal on 16.12.1985 to the State Government for acquiring lands situated at the Village Mora, Taluka Choriyasi, District Surat for the purpose of Gas Base Thermal Power Project for NTPC.
The appellants- claimants thereafter appeared before the Land Acquisition Officer and claimed compensation at the rate of ' 1, 50,000 per acre.
Reference Court enhanced the market value of the land and determined the same at the rate of ' 20 per square meter.
issues: The first submission of the counsel appearing for the parties concerned the market value of the land as determined by the courts below.
The next contention of the counsel appearing for the appellants- claimants was regarding entitlement of appellants to payment of interest on additional amount of compensation and solatium.
petitioner_arguments: According to them, in terms of the documentary as also oral evidence on record, the market value of the land should have been determined at least at the rate of ' 33 per square meter.

The claimants were also held to be entitled to get the interest at the rate of 9 per cent per annum for the first year of taking over of possession of the land in the year 1986 and at the rate of 15 per cent per annum thereafter, excluding the amount of solatium till the realization of the amount by the claimants.
respondent_arguments: The High Court did not grant interest under Section 28 and 34 on additional amount of compensation under Sections 23(1-A) and 23(2) of the Act and held further that no interest shall also be paid on solatium.
court_reasoning: In order to appreciate the rival contentions of the parties, as to whether the market value of the land should be determined at ' 33 per square meter as submitted by the counsel appearing for the appellants- claimants or whether it should be determined at ' 22 per square meter as held by the High Court, we have perused various documentary evidence placed on record by the parties.
holding: The present appeals are registered as against the aforesaid judgment and order of the High Court.
